items.title: MLA Mani C Kappan gets one-year jail term, fined Rs 1.2 crore in cheque-bounce case
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Pala MLA Mani C Kappan has been sentenced to one year of simple imprisonment by a Mumbai court in a cheque-bounce case linked to falsely promising shares in Kannur International Airport. The Additional Metropolitan Magistrate’s Court in Borivali also directed Kappan to pay Rs 1.20 crore as compensation to the complainant, along with 9% simple interest from the date of the order until the amount is realised. The court, presided over by Judge SA Khalane, convicted Kappan under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. He has been directed to pay the compensation within one month. Failure to do so will result in an additional three months of imprisonment. The court also directed the police to issue a non-bailable warrant for the execution of the sentence. The case was filed by Mumbai-based businessman Dinesh Menon who in 2019 had alleged that Kappan swindled him of Rs 3.5 crore after promising shares of Kannur International Airport (KIAL).
